This section tracks active research gaps. It is not a findings page.

## Current priorities

Four of the five commissioning-issue targets remain **copy sought**: the Creekview 202 evaluation, *Keys on Freedom*, ECPM manuals, and original 1993–95 ministry CSIL records. The fifth — the November 2008 synthesis — is now a public Internet Archive scan ([catalogue record](../sources/wanted-2008-program-review.qmd)).

See [Wanted Sources](wanted-sources.qmd) and [catalogue search notes](catalogue-search-notes.qmd).

## How to use this section

- Add a wanted-source record when a document is known or strongly attested but not in hand.
- Keep status labels honest (`known-to-exist-copy-sought`, `physical-copy-known`, `permission-required`, and so on).
- Do not convert a gap list into narrative history.
